images.filename: J.P Boswell, F.W. Rockwell, Holland Smith, C.D. Barrett, F.P. Hardaway, circa 1942 (48358134042).jpg
images.caption:
Back of photo: "Reading left to right, Lieutenant General J. P. Boswell, Commanding Officer Amphibious Assault Training Center, Pacific Beach. Real Admiral F. W. Rockwell, United States Navy...Major General Holland M. Smith, United States Marine Corps Command Amphibious Corps Pacific; Major General C. D. Barrett, United States Marine Corps, Commanding General, 3rd Marine Division; Brigadier General F. P. Hardaway, United States Army, Commanding General, Camp Callan." 
NOTE: Francis P. Hardaway was the new camp's first commander (it opened on 15 January 1941, closed down on 1 November 1945).
From the Holland M. Smith Collection (COLL/2949) at the Marine Corps History Division

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH
